text:p.text:span: Roles inherit downward: each role can do everything the role below it can do, plus their own additional permissions.

Multi-role support: A user can hold multiple roles simultaneously (e.g. Student + Class Rep + Club Head). The most permissive role's rights apply.
Content persistence: When a role is removed from a user, their previously uploaded content remains. Only their upload and management rights are revoked.
Account management: Admin is responsible for account creation, password resets, and deactivation of all non-Developer accounts.
Authentication: All users log in via college email (SSO / OAuth).
